summary.text: Barbara Sharief represents District 35 in the Florida Senate, to which Sharief was elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Sharief served on the Miramar City Commission from 2009 to 2010 and as a Broward County commissioner from 2010 to 2021, including terms as county mayor in 2013 and 2016.

The Senate lists Sharief's occupation as doctor of nursing practice and advanced registered nurse practitioner. Sharief holds a B.S. (1996) and M.S. (2000) in nursing from Florida International University and a Doctor of Nursing Practice from Wilkes University (2017), and was born in Miami Beach.
